hero.headline: Generate a problem set you can actually trust — in minutes.
hero.subhead: Finding or writing good problems eats a Sunday afternoon — and the AI generators that promise to help will hand you a clean-looking question with an answer key that's quietly wrong, the kind you don't catch until a student does. Veradic generates a full set tuned to your course — figures, worked solutions, the works — then re-derives every answer itself, so what you hand out is correct.

flowSetup.title: Start from the course you already teach
flowSetup.caption: Your courses, your units — the starting point. Point Veradic at the course you already teach and it generates a problem set tuned to that exact material, instead of you combing the web for something close enough to assign.

flowSetup.title: A whole problem set, written from your course
flowSetup.caption: Minutes later: a full set drawn from your material — free-response and multiple-choice together, each with its figure and a complete worked solution. Want more? One tap generates the next batch. The blank page is gone.

moment.eyebrow: The moment that sets it apart
moment.title: It re-derives every problem before you ever see it.
moment.body: Most AI generators hand you a problem and a confident answer key — and sometimes that answer is just wrong. Veradic doesn't trust its own first pass. Every problem it writes is independently re-worked from scratch — the figure, the steps, and the final answer all checked against a fresh derivation — and only the ones that survive that check land in your review queue. You're not auditing a black box; you can read the re-derivation yourself.
moment.sell: An AI that grades its own work before it ever reaches your students.
moment.note: Illustrative example, pulled verbatim from our hand-checked Golden Set — the same generated problem and re-derivation shown on the Golden Set page. Not a real student's assignment.

flowResolution.title: Review each problem with its full answer key
flowResolution.caption: Every generated problem opens with its complete worked solution and answer key on the left and an AI Workshop on the right. You're checking and approving the set — not building one from a blank rubric.

flowResolution.title: Refine any problem in plain English
flowResolution.caption: Want a fresh real-world context, a harder version, or different numbers? Just ask. Veradic rewrites the problem — and re-derives the new answer independently, so a quick edit can't quietly break the answer key behind your back.

flowResolution.title: Accept the verified revision
flowResolution.caption: The rewrite arrives already checked — its solution and final answer 're-derived independently rather than written by hand.' Accept it and the verified version replaces the original, with one tap to undo if you change your mind.

flowResolution.title: Approved — ready to assign
flowResolution.caption: Reviewed and approved, nothing rejected. The set is ready to publish to students — every problem trustworthy, the whole thing built in less time than it used to take to write one.

payoff.title: What a teacher gets back.
payoff.lead: Not another tool that makes more work. Four things that change how a problem set comes together:

points.title: Hours of writing, gone
points.body: The set arrives drafted from your own course material. You review and approve instead of staring at a blank page on a Sunday night, hunting for problems that fit the unit.

points.title: An answer key you can trust
points.body: Every problem is independently re-derived before it reaches you — so you're not handing students a question whose 'correct' answer is quietly wrong and finding out from a confused class.

points.title: Figures and solutions, included
points.body: Each problem comes with its diagram and a full worked solution — ready to hand out, ready to teach from, nothing left to sketch by hand or reconstruct later.

points.title: Tuned, then yours to refine
points.body: Generated from your material and your standards, then adjustable in plain English — and nothing reaches a student until you approve it.

payoff.closing: A full problem set tuned to your own course, every answer re-derived and checked, figures and solutions included — and you still approve each one before it reaches a student. That's the whole point.
